ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the tangent to the circle $\odot O$ with $A$ being the point of tangency. The line segments $OA$ and $OB$ are connected. If $\angle B = 35^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since AB is the tangent line of the circle O, \\
it follows that $\angle$OAB=$90^\circ$, \\
Since $\angle$B=$35^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle$AOB=$90^\circ-\angle$B=\boxed{55^\circ}.
